notes.title: Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farewell: The Release is Near!
notes.notes:
Scary Shadow Spot - Last Farwell is now in its final stages! After months of hard work, I am thrilled to announce that the game is almost ready for the official release.

[hr][/hr]

Feedback from Beta Testers I had the privilege of having the game tested by a group of selected beta testers, and their feedback has helped refine every detail. The eerie atmosphere and twists that define the game have been polished to offer you an unforgettable experience.

[hr][/hr]

Inspired by The Twilight Zone The game is inspired by the legendary TV series The Twilight Zone. Every puzzle, every shadow, has been designed to make you doubt what is real and what lurks in the depths of the mind.

[hr][/hr]

Questions? We Are Here to Answer! Do you have any curiosities or questions about Scary Shadow Spot? We are here to answer anything that comes to mind. What secrets are hidden in Mark's house? What awaits you in the darkness? We can't wait to hear your questions!

[hr][/hr]

Thank You for the Support! Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your continued support. Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the release day.

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0 | SIGNIFICANT IMPROVEMENTS
notes.notes:
First update for The Telephone!
As work progresses on a new game scheduled for 2024, here's the first update for The Telephone, adding some interesting new features:

UPDATES:

 Improved the overall game graphics.
 Added a graphic filter. Now the game is even more unsettling and enjoyable to watch.
 Introduced focal distance. All game cinematics have been enhanced.
 Added the ability to run even when inside.
 Added running in the sewers.
 Floaters are now easier to defeat.
 Fixed minor bugs.


If you have an ongoing game, this update will corrupt the save files. In the Steam settings, you can select the version of The Telephone you are playing to continue with your game.
